internalCrossTask.title: Internal cross-task record — not an official RPSGT task
internalCrossTask.note: Retained only for isolated Quality Review records and must not be presented as a 13th RPSGT task.

method.sourceMatch: A question is included when at least one configured book source key appears in the question's referenceKeys or studyRecommendationKeys.
method.taskGrouping: Matched questions use the preserved RPSGT domain and task codes from rpsgt-v3/data/blueprint.json. The five D2A/D2C records remain isolated as an internal non-official cross-task code.
method.chapterLink: Each book outline section lists official RPSGT task codes. Those codes route to exact source-matched question IDs in the workbook.
method.boundary: This is a reproducible source-key/RPSGT-task mapping. It is not a page-level citation audit and does not prove that every item in a task pool is supported by every chapter assigned to that task.
